name: Pradyumna Mahajan
tagline: I build fast, modern web and mobile apps — from pixel-perfect frontends to secure, scalable backends.
bio: I'm a full stack developer at DeccanLogic, Pune, where I build responsive web and mobile interfaces with React.js and React Native. Alongside my full-time role, I take on freelance projects — I've shipped e-commerce stores, desktop apps, and Android apps end to end. My backend toolkit spans Django, Spring Boot and Flask, and I care about performance: lazy loading, code splitting, and clean component architecture are my defaults, not afterthoughts.
